guardian.name: Interception
guardian.text: When a party member within 6 blocks is hit, 20% of the damage is moved to you instead, reduced by your own armour.

guardian.name: Bursting Ward
guardian.text: When one of your barriers breaks, it bursts: enemies within 4 blocks are knocked back and take 25% of the barrier's strength as damage.

guardian.name: Iron Answer
guardian.text: Blocking a hit within 0.5 s of it landing staggers the attacker for 1 s.

brute.name: Aftershock
brute.text: Your slams crack the ground, which erupts 1 s later for 40% of the slam's damage.

brute.name: Hooked
brute.text: Spear and halberd hits on an enemy running away from you pull it 2 blocks back toward you.

brute.name: Unyielding
brute.text: Once every 8 s, the next knockback or stun on you is ignored, and you gain 2 armour toughness for 5 s.

samurai.name: Severing Wind
samurai.text: Katana hits send out a short wind slash, at most once a second, that travels 6 blocks and deals 30% of the hit's damage.

samurai.name: Counter Draw
samurai.text: After a parry, your next attack within 1.5 s dashes you 3 blocks through the attacker, cutting it as you pass.

samurai.name: Crimson Edge
samurai.text: Katana critical hits make the target bleed for 1 damage per second for 4 s.

berserker.name: Blood Price
berserker.text: You can keep attacking with no stamina left, paying 1 health per swing.

berserker.name: Scent of Fear
berserker.text: Enemies below 25% health take 15% more damage from you.

berserker.name: Thick Skull
berserker.text: Stuns on you last half as long.

monk.name: Afterimage
monk.text: A perfect dodge leaves an afterimage of you that enemies within 6 blocks attack for 2 s.

monk.name: Silencing Palm
monk.text: Every fifth unarmed hit on the same enemy silences it for 2 s: no spells and no ranged attacks.

monk.name: Ki Wave
monk.text: Unarmed hits build Ki; after 12 hits, your next punch releases a 5-block shockwave for 100% of its damage.

blaze.name: Wildfire
blaze.text: When a burning enemy takes damage from your spell, its fire spreads to one enemy within 3 blocks.

blaze.name: Fuel the Flames
blaze.text: Hitting a burning enemy with a fire spell restores 3 mana.

blaze.name: Smoulder
blaze.text: Fire you start keeps burning in rain and water.

frost.name: Shatter
frost.text: Enemies killed while frozen shatter into ice shards that hit enemies within 4 blocks for 15% of the dead enemy's max health and slow them.

frost.name: Glacial Step
frost.text: Water freezes under your feet as you walk, and you take no fall damage landing on ice or snow.

frost.name: Cold Snap
frost.text: Every third ice spell you cast freezes the first enemy it hits for 1 s.

water.name: Undertow
water.text: Your water spells pull the enemies they hit 1 block toward you.

water.name: Drenched
water.text: Water spells soak enemies for 5 s: soaked enemies take 15% more lightning and ice damage and can't stay on fire.

water.name: Rising Tide
water.text: Each water spell cast within 5 s of the last costs 5% less mana, up to 25%.

lightning.name: Thunderclap
lightning.text: A kill with a lightning spell sets off a thunderclap that stuns enemies within 3 blocks for 0.5 s.

lightning.name: Static Skin
lightning.text: When you are hit in melee, there is a 20% chance the attacker is shocked for 3 damage.

lightning.name: Surge Step
lightning.text: For 2 s after a lightning spell, your next dodge or step goes twice as far.

holy.name: Martyr's Grace
holy.text: Healing a party member heals you for 30% of the amount.

holy.name: Sanctified Ground
holy.text: Your healing spells leave holy light on the ground for 4 s that burns undead standing in it.

holy.name: Last Light
holy.text: Your heals on a target below 30% health heal 40% more.

warlock.name: Void Echo
warlock.text: Your eldritch and ender spells have a 10% chance to cast again for free at half power.

warlock.name: Soul Debt
warlock.text: Killing an enemy restores mana equal to 5% of its max health, up to 15.

warlock.name: Sculk Whispers
warlock.text: Enemies hit by your spells show through walls for 6 s.

necromancer.name: Corpse Blast
necromancer.text: Your summons explode when they die, dealing 30% of their max health as blood damage within 3 blocks.

necromancer.name: Grave Feast
necromancer.text: When one of your summons dies, you heal 2 health.

necromancer.name: Rise Again
necromancer.text: Enemies you kill have a 10% chance to rise as a zombie that fights for you for 20 s, up to 2 at a time.

druid.name: Venomous Thorns
druid.text: Enemies that hit you in melee are poisoned (Poison I) for 3 s.

druid.name: Pack Howl
druid.text: When you take damage, your summoned wolves and beasts howl and deal 20% more damage for 5 s.

druid.name: Seed Burst
druid.text: An enemy killed by your nature spell leaves a flowering bush that heals allies beside it 1 health per second for 5 s.

jade.name: Jade Mirror
jade.text: Projectiles that hit you have a 15% chance to be reflected back.

jade.name: Perfect Symmetry
jade.text: Alternate a weapon hit and a spell: each one after the other deals 15% more.

jade.name: Celestial Seal
jade.text: Every eighth spell you cast draws a seal beneath you for 5 s: enemies in it are slowed, and you take 15% less damage while inside.

spirit.name: Soul Harvest
spirit.text: Kills leave a soul wisp for 10 s that restores 5% mana when you touch it.

spirit.name: Ghost Lanterns
spirit.text: Your summoned spirits reveal invisible enemies within 8 blocks of them: those enemies glow.

spirit.name: Possession
spirit.text: Hits from your summoned spirits have a 5% chance to turn the enemy to your side for 3 s.

assassin.name: Venomblade
assassin.text: Dagger hits poison the target (Poison I) for 3 s.

assassin.name: Vanish
assassin.text: A Combat Evolution execution (from behind, on an unaware target) makes you invisible for 2 s and resets Shadow Step.

assassin.name: Contagious Mark
assassin.text: When an enemy under Death Mark dies, the mark jumps to the nearest enemy within 8 blocks.

thief.name: Light Fingers
thief.text: Your melee hits have a 5% chance to knock loot from the enemy's drop table, once per enemy.

thief.name: Smoke and Mirrors
thief.text: Using an escape skill leaves a decoy that enemies attack for 3 s.

thief.name: Pocket Sand
thief.text: Enemies you roll past are blinded for 2 s.

stalker.name: Hunter's Mark
stalker.text: Your first arrow on an enemy marks it for 8 s: it glows and takes 10% more damage from everyone.

stalker.name: Ricochet
stalker.text: Arrows that hit have a 20% chance to bounce to another enemy within 6 blocks for half damage.

stalker.name: Retrieval
stalker.text: Arrows that hit an enemy come back to your quiver 40% of the time.

wanderer.name: Scavenger
wanderer.text: Mobs drop 15% more experience and have a 10% chance to drop an extra piece of food.

wanderer.name: Horse Whisperer
wanderer.text: Your mounts move 15% faster and take half fall damage.

wanderer.name: Night Eyes
wanderer.text: In places with light level 4 or lower, you see as if you had Night Vision.
